question: Who among the following founded the Khudai Khidmatgars or the Red Shirts, a powerful non-violent movement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Khudai Khidmatgars, also known as the Red Shirts, were founded by **Bacha Khan **(also known as **Ghaffar Khan**) in the early **20th century.**
 
• Bacha Khan was a prominent Indian freedom fighter and a** close associate of Mahatma Gandhi.**
 
• The movement aimed to **promote non-violent resistance against British **colonial rule in India, particularly in the **North-West Frontier Province **(now Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan).
 
• The Khudai Khidmatgars emphasized social reforms, education, and the upliftment of the Pashtun community while advocating for Indian independence through peaceful means.
